title: AccMoS: Accelerating Model Simulation for Simulink via Code Generation
problem: Simulink simulations become time-consuming as model scale and complexity grow in industrial applications. Detecting potential errors, especially accumulative errors, requires extensive simulation to achieve high coverage.
motivation: Simulink is widely used for embedded software development and validation, making efficient simulation critical for detecting errors before deployment.
method: AccMoS speeds up Simulink simulations by converting models into compiled code rather than using an interpreter that processes the model step-by-step during each simulation run. Compiled code runs much faster than interpretation, allowing many more simulation cycles to complete in the time previously needed for just a few—critical for finding errors that only surface after extended runs. The approach maintains model correctness while making comprehensive error detection feasible.
key_novelty: Using compiled code generation instead of interpretation to speed up Simulink simulation and make detection of long-running accumulative errors practical.
contributions: Code generation framework for accelerating Simulink model simulation
Enhanced detection of accumulative errors through faster execution
Improved simulation coverage for industrial-scale complex models
AccMoS tool implementation for practical Simulink users
primary_theme: Accelerated Simulink simulation via code generation
